A full labelled year at 1,200 mg every three weeks is 20,800 mg (DailyMed setid 6fa682c9-a312-4932-9831-f286908660ee gives 840 mg every 2 weeks, 1,200 mg every 3 weeks or 1,680 mg every 4 weeks, which are the same annual total). 7,970/20,800 = 0.3832 of a labelled year, and 1 - 0.3832 = 0.6168. The ratio is stable and drifting up across the series: 0.337 (2020), 0.349 (2021), 0.369 (2022), 0.385 (2023), 0.383 (2024)
column12: Judgement on method. The pool here is Tecentriq's own patients across every labelled indication rather than one trial's median, which is why it is measured rather than taken from a duration of response. The case against: the fixed one-year adjuvant courses in non-small cell lung and bladder cancer put a ceiling on consumption that is not discontinuation, so the true stopping rate in the treat-to-progression indications is lower than this

column11: two shares multiplied. (1) The rectal share of colorectal cancer: 'rectal cancer now makes up nearly one-third (32%, up from 27% in the mid-2000s) of all colorectal cancer diagnoses' (American Cancer Society, Colorectal Cancer Facts and Figures 2026, cancer.org press release 'Rectal Cancer Incidence Rising After Decades of Decline', March 2026). (2) The locally advanced share: NCT05009069 enrols resectable rectal adenocarcinoma staged cT3 node-positive or cT4 any node, with metastatic disease excluded, which is regional-stage disease. SEER 21 (2016-2022) puts 37% of colorectal cancers at regional stage, against 34% localized, 23% distant and 6% unstaged (SEER Cancer Stat Facts, Percent of Cases by Stage). 0.32 x 0.37 = 0.1184
column12: the stage share is a proxy and it cuts both ways. SEER's 'regional' means spread to regional lymph nodes, which is the trial's cT3N+ arm, but the trial also admits cT4 node-negative disease that SEER would call localized, so this understates. Against that, not every locally advanced rectal patient completes neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy and goes on to adjuvant immunotherapy. A narrower restriction the trial does not impose: it does not select on mismatch repair status

column11: a judgement for a checkpoint inhibitor added after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in a setting where the standard of care is now total neoadjuvant therapy followed by surgery or watch-and-wait, and where the immunotherapy story in rectal cancer belongs to mismatch-repair-deficient disease and to dostarlimab rather than to an unselected PD-L1 antibody. Set against that, there is no approved immunotherapy at all for the mismatch-repair-proficient majority this study enrols

a judgement set well below the published chain, and the row to argue with. NCT05009069 reached primary completion on 2023-11-21, has 58 participants enrolled, still reads 'Active, not recruiting' and has posted no results, three years on and after a last registry update of 2026-07-28 (ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, read 2026-10-27). Its randomisation is against atezolizumab plus tiragolumab, the TIGIT antibody whose Phase 3 programme Roche has wound down. The published transitions remaining to a Phase 2 on the Oncology cut would give 0.246 x 0.477 x 0.920 = 0.108 (BIO/Informa Pharma Intelligence/QLS Advisors, 2011-2020, Figure 2 page 7), and a readout that has passed in silence for three years is read at about half of that

column11: two shares multiplied. (1) The resectable locally advanced share: NCT04661150 enrols cT3, cT4a or cT4b or node-positive, M0 disease that is surgically resectable. SEER 21 (2016-2022) puts 23% of stomach cancers at regional stage, against 32% localized, 35% distant and 9% unstaged (SEER Cancer Stat Facts, Percent of Cases by Stage). (2) The HER2-positive share: 22.1% across tumour samples analysed in the ToGA screening programme, 21.4% for gastric primaries and 32.2% for gastroesophageal junction primaries (Van Cutsem E, Bang YJ, Feng-Yi F, et al., 'HER2 screening data from ToGA: targeting HER2 in gastric and gastroesophageal junction cancer', Gastric Cancer 2015;18(3):476-484, doi:10.1007/s10120-014-0402-y, PMID 25038874). 0.23 x 0.221 = 0.0508
column12: both shares are proxies and this is the weaker of the two eligible rows in this file. SEER's 'regional' is node-positive disease, which is most but not all of the trial's criteria - cT3 and cT4 node-negative disease sits in SEER's 'localized' - so the stage share understates. The ToGA HER2 rate was measured in advanced and metastatic disease rather than in resectable disease, where the mix of intestinal-type tumours and so the HER2 rate may differ. Not applied at all, and biasing this high: fitness for perioperative chemotherapy and surgery, which excludes part of an elderly population

a judgement set below the published chain, on a stated result. NCT04661150 is completed, reported on 2023-05-08 and has posted results: pathological complete response in 38.1% of the atezolizumab arm (95% CI 18.1-61.6) against 14.3% of the trastuzumab plus XELOX control (95% CI 3.0-36.3), p=0.079 in 42 patients (ClinicalTrials.gov results section, read 2026-10-27). The point estimate is a near-trebling and the direction is right, but the difference did not reach conventional significance and three and a half years later no Phase 3 of atezolizumab in gastric cancer is registered. The published Oncology transitions from Phase 2 would give 0.246 x 0.477 x 0.920 = 0.108 (BIO/Informa Pharma Intelligence/QLS Advisors, 2011-2020, Figure 2 page 7); this is read below that because the Phase 2 gate has already been attempted and the programme has not advanced
